evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template is selected when creating a new document object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents are uploaded to a document cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: A new document is generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Document content is edited.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: A document is saved.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is converted to PDF by the system.

evts.name: display_document_pdf
evts.description: The current converted document version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned to a document.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned through document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next document version.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited document versions are deleted after out-of-force declaration.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process is initiated after creation, maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete their review task positively or reject it.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete their release task positively or reject it.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is finally released.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a document is created.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights employee creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is completed and no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a request 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A validity extension request is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared for a document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A request for AKS is created for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: The request for AKS is processed by the applicable workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document and its attachments are declared invalid/out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: A document is archived by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and a corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is processed by the request creator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is revalidated and restored through creation of a new version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: A distribution list is maintained for a document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Users or persons are informed by e-mail notification.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned groups are requested by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: update_dashboard
evts.description: Dashboards are filled based on groups assigned to document distribution.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: A role-specific evaluation report is run using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: A translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: For a document in a multi-client system, visible clients are specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in a client for a local addition.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference is created from a local document to the original document.
